apps.name: DroneDeploy Flight App
apps.releaseNotes:
New Features

  - RTK connect in flight — Drones can now connect to RTK mid-flight by pausing at the first waypoint, suspending, then resuming
  - Starting waypoint offset slider — New planning UI control to calibrate the starting waypoint position on long flight legs
  - Terrain Awareness — Expanded acreage limit for terrain awareness missions
  - Flight log timestamps — Timestamps now shown alongside entries in the timeline viewer

  Improvements

  - Firmware alerts — Only flags firmware that is genuinely older than required, reducing false update prompts
  - Camera display names — All supported cameras now show human-readable names throughout the app
  - Travel altitude — Resets automatically when switching back to automatic altitude settings
  - RTK stability — Consolidated connection paths and prompts drone reset when RTK datum changes mid-connection
  - Mission reliability — Flight path changes are now applied synchronously; numeric values in mission JSON rounded to prevent floating-point drift

  Bug Fixes

  - App startup & navigation — Fixed 60-second startup delay on legacy-auth devices and unsigned sessions; fixed invisible text on the active mobile
  nav tab
  - Missions & planning — Fixed geofence RTH marked as failed when all waypoints completed; fixed image count using stale data after flight path
  changes; fixed non-resumable missions appearing in the queue; fixed approach waypoint heading
  - Capture — Fixed pano missions capturing half the expected photos on thermal drones; fixed Progress Video recording before the gimbal reached its
  planned angle
  - Stand assessment — Fixed markers not loading, gimbal angle on first photo, and PDF reports downloading as 0 bytes
  - Map & visualization — Fixed FPV view maximizing to map instead of camera from vertical layout; fixed wrong direction in aircraft detection
  messages

Check out what's coming to Cyberpunk 2077 in the Edgerunners 2 Update!

Thought you were done with Night City? Well, Night City's not quite done with you!

Patch notes for Cyberpunk 2077's Edgerunners 2 Update (2.5) are now available for your early perusal before the update hits the streets on October 22nd. Watch the Features Overview video to see some of the new features in action:

PREMIUM SERVERS

Today at 19:00 UTC, we're issuing a mandatory update - We are rolling out Premium Servers, an experimental way to filter out cheat users and create a better experience for legit players.

To access Premium Servers, your Rust Steam inventory must be valued at $15 or more. This includes items from the Permanent Item Store, such as building skins, décor packs, and hazmat skins, as well as any other tradable Rust items with an attached value. Currently we do not include Rust's standalone DLC such as Instruments, Sunburn and Voice Props packs (this may change in future).

We initially communicated a $20 threshold, but after analysing data from millions of accounts, we've settled on $15 as a more effective starting point. This is based on a comparison of banned accounts versus regular players, aiming to strike a balance between accessibility and cheat deterrence, although opting on the lower end.

• Premium Servers will only be visible if your account meets the $15 threshold.

• Premium Servers will show a Premium (and clickable) Tag to provide details about eligibility.

• This won’t stop every cheat user, but it’s an extra layer of friction against disposable cheat accounts.

• Server owners can opt-in by enabling the following convar: "server.premium 1"

• The $15 threshold may change over time, and we may introduce additional factors to refine premium status.

• Depending on Steam traffic, brand new purchases may take up to 20 minutes to reflect onto the Premium Server authorization.

• You can manually refresh or check your premium status by going to the server listings, clicking the premium server tag and clicking the refresh icon.

• If you have premium status, it'll display on your avatar on the menu menu

If we encounter any abuse or exploitation of Premium servers or the market, user accounts will be banned. All trades of Rust skins are logged.

SERVERS

There are currently several new freshly wiped official premium servers going live today at 19:00 UTC.

To connect to these servers, you'll find them in the official server list or connect directly from the mainmenu, open the console by pressing F1 and typing "connect" followed by the IP or endpoint. For example, "connect eupremium.rustopia.gg" or "connect 79.137.98.213:28015"

apps.name: Marvel Rivals
apps.releaseNotes:
Marvel Rivals Version 20260417 Balance Post

We've got another round of tweaks coming to Marvel Rivals. We're rolling out a brand-new Chain-CC Protection system to save you from endless stun-locks, Bucky Barnes is trading in his crowd control for pure firepower, and Ultron is expanding his robotic wrath across the battlefield.

Let's dive in and see how the meta is shifting!

 

ADJUSTMENTS

Chain-CC Protection

In Season 7.5, we introduced the Chain-CC (Crowd Control) Protection mechanic to ensure combat remains fluid and fair. Here are the specific rules:

- The Trigger: If a Hero suffers 5.5 seconds of total CC duration or is hit by 6 CC effects within a 7-second window, Chain-CC Protection activates. This instantly purges all active CC effects and grants the Hero 30% Tenacity for 3 seconds.
- Scaling Tenacity: Tenacity proportionally reduces the duration of incoming CC. While active, every new CC effect applied to the Hero increases their Tenacity by 10% and extends the buff's duration by 0.5 seconds.
- Total Immunity: If Tenacity reaches 100%, the Hero becomes completely CC Immune until the buff expires. During this window, incoming CC will not grant further Tenacity or extend the Immunity duration.
- Cinematic Exceptions: Certain animation-driven CC effects (such as Emma Frost's Carbon Crush and Monster Hulk's World Breaker) bypass this system. Tenacity cannot reduce their durations, nor will they be interrupted if Chain-CC Protection triggers. Any standard CC effects applied during these cinematic moves will be cleared, and Tenacity applied, only after the cinematic ability concludes.
- Cooldown: The Chain-CC Protection system has a 5-second cooldown, which begins the moment the final Tenacity effect expires.

 

VANGUARD

Emma Frost

We're slightly lowering the energy cost of the White Queen's Ultimate to boost her suppression power on the battlefield. Time to shine, darling!
- Reduce the energy cost of Psionic Seduction (Ultimate Ability) from 3400 to 3100.

Deadpool (Vanguard)

We're slightly dialing back Vanguard-pool's burst damage and the survivability gains from his gun-form Ultimate. Gotta keep things fair, even for the Merc with a Mouth! 
- Reduce The Ban Hammer (Gun Form Ultimate Ability) Bonus Health gained per hammer hit from 80 to 60 (standard) and from 80 to 70 (upgraded).
- Reduce The Ban Hammer (Gun Form Ultimate Ability) damage dealt per hammer hit from 45 to 35. 
- Reduce bonus Attack Speed provided by Deadpool in Your Area - Vanguard to Dual Desert Eagles - Vanguard from 60% to 40%.

Peni Parker

We're slightly reducing Peni's base survivability but enhancing the deployment range and protection of her Cyber-Webs, while also improving the hit experience of her Primary Attack. This aims to strengthen Peni in positional warfare! Now she can cover more ground with her Cyber-Webs, and flexibly using their support effects will help the team handle specific enemy dives with more ease!
- Reduce base health from 700 to 650.
- Increase the maximum number of Cyber-Webs that can exist simultaneously on the field from 3 to 4.
- Increase Bonus Health cap provided to Peni by Cyber-Webs from 150 to 200.
- Increase Cyber-Web Cluster Projectile Speed from 120m/s to 150m/s.

 

DUELIST

Elsa Bloodstone

We're reining in Elsa's mobility and her threat level against Vanguards. The monster hunter needs to pace herself out there in the timestream!
- Increase Helix Advance cooldown from 8s to 10s. (Cooldown at max passive stacks from 2s to 4s).
- Reduce Monster-Piercer percentage damage per pellet from 1.2% to 0.8%.
   Reduce total percentage damage when all 5 pellets hit from 6% to 4%.
   Zhiyong Note: When all pellets hit, damage against a 275 HP hero drops from 81.5 (13*5+275*6%) to 76; against a 700 HP hero, it drops from 107 (13*5+700*6%) to 93.

Human Torch

apps.name: Mozilla Firefox (en-US)
apps.releaseNotes:
Version 159.0, first offered to Release channel users on October 27, 2026

New
- Sharing on macOS now uses the native macOS share picker, which shows a preview of the page and recent contacts alongside AirDrop, Messages, and other apps. Several selected tabs can also be shared at once.

- Saved passwords are now available from the sidebar by default, without having to add the Passwords tool first.

- Smart Window can now watch pages for changes such as price drops or restocks. Type /watch in the chat to set one up, and Firefox sends a desktop notification when it finds a match. Watches can be managed from the Tasks button in the toolbar or the about:smartwindowtasks page.
  This feature is part of a progressive roll out.
  What is a progressive roll out?
  Certain new Firefox features are released gradually. This means some users will see the feature before everyone does. This approach helps to get early feedback to catch bugs and improve behavior quickly, meaning more Firefox users overall have a better experience.

Fixed
- Fixed the file upload dialog opening in the last folder a file was saved to, such as Downloads, instead of the folder last used for uploads.
- Fixed memory usage growing rapidly when sites such as the Zoom web app were left open in a minimized window.
- Fixed some videos displaying incorrectly on Windows when NVIDIA RTX Video HDR is enabled.
- Fixed bookmarks not being imported from Google Chrome profiles that are signed in to a Google account.
- Fixed the Replace button in Apple Writing Tools on macOS inserting the clipboard contents instead of the rewritten text on some sites, such as Gmail.
- Fixed long drop-down lists on web pages sometimes showing blank space in place of the last options until the list was scrolled.
- Fixed some sites, such as Slack, failing to load instead of falling back to HTTP/2 when the site rejected an HTTP/3 request.
- Fixed Firefox using excessive memory on Linux with AMD graphics when viewing map or place results on sites such as ChatGPT.
- Fixed quick gamepad button presses sometimes being missed in web games on macOS.
- Fixed tabs sometimes detaching into a new window when clicked on Linux with Wayland.
- Fixed menus and panels fading in on Windows and Linux when animation effects are turned off in the operating system.
- Various security fixes.

Changed
- On macOS, apps that sign in through the default browser, such as ChatGPT, now open their sign-in page in Firefox instead of Safari when Firefox is the default browser.
- The AI chatbot's Summarize page option now sends the page's address to the chatbot provider instead of the page's text, so long pages are no longer cut short to a partial summary.
- Open tabs can now be searched with a keyboard shortcut: Ctrl+Shift+A on Windows and Linux, Cmd+Shift+A on macOS. The Extensions and Themes shortcut is now Ctrl+Shift+F on Windows and Linux, and Cmd+Shift+E on macOS. These shortcuts can be changed in about:keyboard.
- Web addresses written in the Javanese, Balinese, Canadian Aboriginal Syllabics, and N'Ko scripts are now displayed in their own script instead of as encoded "xn--" text.

Enterprise
- For Firefox Enterprise updates and fixes, see the Firefox Enterprise release notes. For policy changes, see the Firefox admin docs changelog.

Developer
- The Web Console now allows let, const, and class variables to be declared again, so a snippet can be edited and re-run without a redeclaration error.

Web Platform
- Firefox now supports scroll-driven animations, so CSS animations and Web Animations API animations can progress with the scroll position of a container or with an element's visibility as it scrolls into view. This adds the animation-timeline, scroll-timeline, view-timeline, and animation-range properties and the ScrollTimeline and ViewTimeline interfaces.
- Firefox now supports scoped custom element registries. A registry created with the CustomElementRegistry() constructor is separate from the global window.customElem…
